behaviour: oviposition preference on milkweed species by infected and uninfected females

direction_semantics.accept: A milkweed is directly preferred for oviposition in a reported observation or choice test.
direction_semantics.reject: A milkweed is directly avoided in an oviposition choice test.
direction_semantics.unknown: A milkweed is absent from a list or lacks a direct preference or avoidance observation.

assay_mismatch: Ophryocystis elektroscirrha is outside the configured ChEMBL assay panel; fungal bioactivity is a coverage probe and does not test the monarch-parasite mechanism.
expected_outcome: This system has the strongest behavioural design in the set and loses coverage at the assay join, showing that the measured assay wall generalises.
europe_pmc_query: TITLE_ABS:(monarch OR Danaus plexippus) AND TITLE_ABS:(oviposition OR milkweed OR Asclepias) AND (cardenolide OR parasite OR Ophryocystis OR preference) AND OPEN_ACCESS:Y
